description: KNa₃H₄ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the cubic Pm̅3m space group. K is bonded to six H atoms to form KH₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent KH₆ octahedra and edges with twelve equivalent NaH₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All K-H bond lengths are 2.56 Å. Na is bonded to six H atoms to form NaH₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaH₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent KH₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent NaH₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-H bond lengths are 2.56 Å. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded to six equivalent Na atoms to form HNa₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent HNa₆ octahedra and edges with twelve HK₂Na₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the second H site, H is bonded to two equivalent K and four equivalent Na atoms to form HK₂Na₄ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent HK₂Na₄ octahedra and edges with twelve HNa₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All H-Na bond lengths are 2.56 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded to two equivalent K and four equivalent Na atoms to form HK₂Na₄ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent HK₂Na₄ octahedra and edges with twelve HNa₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the fourth H site, H is bonded to two equivalent K and four equivalent Na atoms to form HK₂Na₄ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent HK₂Na₄ octahedra and edges with twelve HNa₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
